XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sudden engine shutdown while running, with subsequent smooth restart
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P0191 | PUMP | HIGH | PRESSURE | FUEL | DIESEL | SHUTS DOWN | STOPS | LOCKED | STALLS | MOTION | ROAD | RUN | RESTART | IMMEDIATELY |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Fuel supply

  • Component: High-pressure fuel pump

  • Fault: The engine occasionally stalls whilst driving with the engine warm; it restarts normally afterwards.

  • Faults detected by self-diagnosis: P0191 (Fuel line pressure sensor – Incorrect setpoint)

  • Cause: Faulty high-pressure fuel pump

• Action: Check the condition of the high-pressure fuel pump and, if necessary, overhaul or replace it.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: Following the overhaul of the high-pressure fuel pump, the problem was permanently resolved. The component is located between the engine and the radiator, on the upper part of the engine, on the passenger side.
